args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** (error rate 0.18).
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to v2.3.0 in all production regions — the rollback was approved and verified (`rolled_out`).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 for checkout-api, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.

The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
